variants.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE finished Korean event-detail poster for creator platform "crefans". Portrait 2:3 ratio, high resolution, full bleed flat graphic artwork, no phone mockup, no outer presentation board. This is one of five alternative design concepts.
All designs communicate the following SAME exact benefits. Clear modern Korean sans-serif, like Pretendard; high readability, neat Korean letterforms, not calligraphy. Hierarchy favors benefit amounts over eligibility counts. Do NOT invent dates or claims. Maintain four readable reward sections with ample padding.
Exact text and hierarchy:
Small brand at top: "crefans"
Hero heading: "크레팬스 베타 1기"
Hero subheading: "함께 만들어 주셔서 감사합니다"
Reward 1: small label "참여자 전원"; prominent "한정 배지"; supporting "‘크레팬스 베타 1기’"; supporting "표시·숨김을 직접 선택".
Reward 2: small label "크리에이터 3명"; prominent "1만원 상당 선물"; second benefit "주목할 크리에이터 30일 노출권".
Reward 3: small label "팬 참여 혜택"; prominent big "프로모션 100콩". CRITICAL: the text "팬 참여자 13명" must appear ONLY ONCE, discreetly in the BOTTOM RIGHT corner inside this third reward area, right-aligned, small regular weight, muted secondary text. Never put 13명 in a badge, headline, bright pill or large type. It should feel like an unobtrusive eligibility footnote, about a quarter the size of "프로모션 100콩" but still legible. The main emphasis must be 100콩. Keep this eligibility note close to the fan benefit, not to a different reward.
Reward 4: small label "유용한 피드백 제공자 최대 3명"; prominent "5천원 상품권".
Footer small text: "참여 기간과 혜택 지급 일정은 별도 안내합니다."
No CTA button, no QR code, no additional prices, no invented event dates. No em dash. No more than 3 green beans in any illustration, avoid clutter. Korean text accuracy is essential. Do not print any concept number or style explanation in the poster.
Style direction for this alternative:
Premium airy white and pastel lilac, navy text, restrained pink-to-periwinkle accents. Refined soft 3D gift box with satin pink ribbon and a purple star badge in a compact top hero. Four generous white panels with very soft tinted edge shadows arranged vertically. Tiny green cream-centered beans accompany the 100콩 benefit. Large whitespace and moderate headings, more sophisticated and less crowded than a game advertisement. The eligibility footnote in the fan panel bottom-right is muted slate gray. Friendly and polished, current Korean consumer tech branding.
